observations.behavior: Adds free_only column to scanner budget and quota state, and its use in budget and credit calculations.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision quota enforcement and billing projections now distinguish free-only scanners, which share an org-wide free credit pool rather than having individual caps. This could prevent over-subscription of shared free credits and tighten the remaining-cap calculation.

observations.behavior: Adds include_free_credits and org_state parameters, and free-only budget merging, to scanner budget computation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows callers to reuse an existing org state and avoid redundant database reads. Merges free-only scanner budgets with the org's free credit pool, potentially reducing database load and improving consistency of remaining-cap calculations.

observations.behavior: Adds free_only column to backfill rows and separates paid and free-only committed credits.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the billing projection to distinguish between paid and free-only backfill commitments, supporting accurate remaining-cap and shared-pool enforcement.

observations.behavior: Adds a free-credits-only admission path and a spend-ceiling enforcement, while retaining the existing credit-limit path.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether an organization has a free-credits-only ceiling and whether a scanner is free-only, then uses that ceiling instead of the org's billing limit. This could prevent a free-only scanner from consuming paid credits or from exceeding a free-only ceiling. The callers also record a scanner-limit-reached event and send a usage-spike notification, rather than a quota-exhausted

observations.behavior: Adds a boolean field free_only to the ReplayScanner API request/response and its Zod validation, alongside documentation updates.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to request a scanner that only runs while the organization has free credits, without adding to the paid credit limit.

observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to distinguish whether a scanner stopped because of its own paid limit or because the organization's free credits were exhausted.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional boolean parameter 'free_only' to the VisionScanners API request body.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Replay Vision agent to configure a scanner to only run while the organization has free credits, preventing spend. This could help users avoid unexpected costs when using the Replay Vision feature.

observations.behavior: Adds the same 'free_only' parameter to the partial update API request body.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows updating an existing scanner's configuration to enable or disable the free-only mode, supporting lifecycle management of the agent's billing behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional serialization of the 'free_only' parameter into the outgoing request body when the parameter is provided.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the typed API parameter to the actual request payload, ensuring the billing preference is transmitted to the backend service.
